other.tags: Indie folk instrumental featuring a prominent acoustic guitar and a rhythmic shaker. The acoustic guitar plays a bright, fingerpicked melody in G major at 110 BPM. A wooden shaker provides a steady sixteenth-note pulse. The arrangement is minimalist, focusing on the interplay between the percussive guitar strums and the high-frequency shaker. The guitar tone is natural and woody with light room reverb. The track maintains a consistent 4/4 time signature throughout. The melodic structure consists of a repeating four-bar phrase with subtle variations in the fingerpicking pattern. The dynamics remain steady with no significant builds or drops.

[Intro]
[bright fingerpicked acoustic guitar enters]
[steady sixteenth-note shaker enters]

[Main Theme]
[acoustic guitar plays melodic arpeggios with percussive muted strums]

A clean electric guitar performs a repetitive, syncopated two-note riff using a slight chorus effect. The drum kit maintains a steady groove with a tight snare and consistent hi-hat eighth notes. A second electric guitar enters with a distorted, fuzzy tone playing sustained power chords and melodic lead lines. The arrangement follows a linear progression, building intensity through the addition of layered guitar textures and increased cymbal activity. 120 BPM, 4/4 time signature, Key of A Minor.

drums.tags: Hard rock instrumental featuring a prominent, syncopated electric bass line and driving acoustic drums. The track is in the key of E minor at 120 BPM. A distorted electric guitar enters with rhythmic power chords and palm-muted chugging. The arrangement is centered on a heavy, mid-tempo groove with the bass guitar providing the melodic hook through a repetitive, percussive riff. The drums utilize a standard rock kit with a crisp snare and active hi-hat patterns. The production is clean with minimal effects, focusing on the raw timbre of the overdriven guitar and the punchy low-end of the bass. The structure alternates between bass-driven sections and full-band crescendos with layered guitar tracks.
